programs.title: Ike: Countdown to D-Day
programs.desc: Gen. Dwight D. Eisenhower (Tom Selleck) faces monumental decisions in the 90 days leading to the Allied invasion of Normandy in 1944.

programs.title: Beyond Valkyrie: Dawn of the Fourth Reich
programs.desc: American and British special forces soldiers are sent to extract a resistance fighter from behind the Nazi lines near the end of World War II.

programs.title: Okinawa
programs.desc: The courageous crew of the World War II battleship U.S.S. Drake paves the way for the invasion of Okinawa.

programs.title: Company of Heroes
programs.desc: During World War II, a group of American soldiers heads to the heart of Nazi Germany to find a scientist who developed a devastating weapon for Hitler and now wants to defect.

programs.title: Hollow Man
programs.desc: The thought of human invisibility has intrigued man for centuries. Highly gifted scientist Sebastian Caine develops a serum that induces complete invisibility. His remarkable transformation results in unimaginable power that seems to suffocate his sense of morality and leads to a furious and frightening conclusion.

programs.title: The Unforgiven
programs.desc: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. A stranger (Joseph Wiseman) appears and disturbs their bucolic existence by spreading a malicious rumor that their adopted daughter, Rachel (Audrey Hepburn), is a Kiowa Native American. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa.
